pr_title: fix: do not change glob pattern when converting to url
pr_body:
* Always treat `?` as escaped `?`. Suggest `*` to match any character.
* Dropped support for char sets `[...]`. `[` and `]` are treated same as escaped `\[` and `\]`. We didn't find any use of it on GitHub and it just complicates the code.

Fixes https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/34915

issue_context.title: [Bug]: Incorrect behavior of '?' in the url glob pattern

review_comments: Unfortunately, it didn't work. The slashes are properly inserted after domain only for known schemas (http:, ws:).
It has to be a "special scheme", defined here: https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#special-scheme
I don't see a test for escaped ? (we've seen a bunch in the wild). Also not seeing where you support it.

> I don't see a test for escaped ? (we've seen a bunch in the wild).

There is a few tests in `interception.spec.ts` and also in `tests/page/page-route.spec.ts`. Escaped behavior didn't change.

> Also not seeing where you support it.

See changes in `urlMatcher.ts`
